subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the core Claws lifecycle and permit this second mutating agent/root-install slice to land after its base PR?
rationale: Code review cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently adopt the CLI, manifest, provenance, partial-recovery, and upgrade contracts defined by the still-open RFC.

options.title: Continue stacked incubation
options.body: Keep this PR open and ordered behind the base while the RFC contract, upgrade behavior, and exact-head recovery proof are completed.

options.title: Sponsor and land in order
options.body: Approve the core direction, land the base first, require live recovery proof, and then merge this slice with the compatibility contract explicitly owned.

options.title: Decline the core lifecycle
options.body: If Claws should not become a core product surface, close the implementation stack rather than continuing compatibility-sensitive repair work.

recommendation.title: Continue stacked incubation
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and ordered behind the base while the RFC contract, upgrade behavior, and exact-head recovery proof are completed.

likelyOwner.reason: Shared-state history and prior review evidence make this person the strongest available owner for both the persistence boundary and core lifecycle sponsorship decision.
